Insurance

Travel Insurance for Kenyans

Travel insurance covers the costs that can derail a trip, mainly emergency medical treatment abroad, plus things like trip cancellation, delay and lost luggage depending on the plan. For many destinations, it also supports visa applications.

Request a quoteSpeak to an advisor

General information only. What is covered, the terms and the premium depend on the insurer’s policy wording, your circumstances and the information you disclose. Nothing here is a promise of cover.

What it covers

  • Emergency medical expenses and repatriation
  • Trip cancellation or curtailment, on plans that include them
  • Baggage and personal belongings loss
  • Travel delay and missed connections, where included

Who needs it

  • Holiday and visiting-family travellers
  • Students and people relocating
  • Business travellers and corporates
  • Anyone applying for a visa that asks for insurance

Common risks

Medical costs abroad

Treatment in some countries is very expensive and is paid up front unless insurance steps in.

Pre-existing conditions

These can be excluded or need declaration.

Activities

Adventure sports and certain activities may be excluded.

Important considerations and exclusions

  • Plans have benefit limits, excesses and exclusions.
  • Cover rarely applies to events known before purchase.
  • Visa authorities set their own requirements. Check them for your trip.

What affects the premium

  • Destination
  • Trip length
  • Traveller age
  • Benefit limits
  • Single trip or annual
  • Activities

Premiums are set by insurers, so we do not publish figures. Tell us about your situation and we will explain what is driving the quotation.

What we need for a quotation

  • Destination and travel dates
  • Traveller details
  • Trip purpose and activities
  • Medical conditions to declare

How Chestnut can help

We explain the cover in plain language, collect the information insurers need, approach suitable insurers for terms, and help with renewals and claims. Policies are issued by insurers, and you decide what to buy.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need travel insurance for every trip?

It is strongly advisable for international trips and is required for some visas. Check the requirements of the destination.

Single trip or annual?

If you travel several times a year, annual cover can be more practical. We compare based on how often and how long you travel.
